title: OWC's Best Mac Accessories Are on Sale Just for MacRumors Readers
content:
MacRumors has partnered with OWC to bring our readers big savings on the retailer's best Thunderbolt docks, USB-C cables, and external storage enclosures. These exclusive deals will run through Monday, September 21 at 12:00 a.m. CST, so you have the rest of this week to shop.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with OWC. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

All discounts have been applied automatically, so all you need to do is follow the links below and add one of the accessories to your cart to see the savings. There are seven total items on sale, including two docks, three enclosures, and two USB-C cables.

$50 OFF
OWC 11-Port Thunderbolt Dock for $179.99

$205 OFF
OWC Express 4M2 Ultra Enclosure for $244.99


The two docks on sale include the OWC 11-Port Thunderbolt 5 Dock for $229.99 ($90 off), and the 11-Port Thunderbolt Dock for $179.99 ($50 off). These docks expand the capabilities of your Mac setup by adding 11 additional ports to your computer.

One of the overall steepest discounts in our exclusive sale is on the OWC Express 4M2 Ultra Enclosure, which is on sale for $244.99 ($205 off). Below you'll find additional desktop RAID systems on sale, as well as two USB-C cables at low prices.

  • OWC 11-Port Thunderbolt Dock - $179.99, down from $229.99

  • OWC 11-Port Thunderbolt 5 Dock - $229.99, down from $319.99

  • OWC Express 1M2 80G Enclosure - $114.99, down from $149.99

  • OWC Express 4M2 Ultra Enclosure - $244.99, down from $449.99

  • OWC ThunderBay 4 Enclosure - $309.99, down from $399.99

  • OWC Thunderbolt 5 USB-C Cable, 1.0M - $19.99, down from $34.99

  • OWC Thunderbolt 4 USB-C Cable, 2.0M - $39.99, down from $57.99
